tweets.text:
If you "hate bonds" and refuse to own them, you may be missing what a big chunk of the market is figuring out.
- For the first time in 15-years, without artificial rate suppression, investors are getting paid to "buy safety" and fixed income is winning the argument over equities. 
- What many investors have forgotten is that the run up in equities since 2009 was there was "no alternative" and cash yielded zero (part of the GFC recovery plan).  Today, bond yields now provide an alternative to risk.
- Fixed income flows are very strong with Government bonds leading the way.
